stories.summary: Barack Obama reportedly urged Democrats at a closed-door Manhattan fundraiser to prioritise a public discussion about artificial-intelligence management and safety. He called for a broad framework covering issues from a possible safety slowdown to AI-related job losses.

stories.title: ‘Really helpful’: the AI bootcamps aimed at addressing UK youth unemployment
stories.summary: A three-week AI bootcamp pilot in Preston is seeking to address youth unemployment by training young people who are not in education, employment or training. The programme includes an apprenticeship opportunity at the end and tests whether AI can help ease, rather than worsen, employment pressures.
